note: Task evals are DEFINED but have NOT been run with and without the skill. Scripted assertions use scripts/handoff_note_check.py as one measure; the judged assertions need a blind grader.

evals.prompt: We have spent the afternoon fixing rounding in the cart total in this repo and the context is nearly full. Write a handoff note for the next session and save it as HANDOFF-2026-11-21.md.
assertions: [script] handoff_note_check.py reports ok true with --root set to the repo
[script] the Changes made section names src/cart.py and tests/test_cart.py in backticks
[script] every Verification line has a command in backticks and a result or says not run
[judge] no success claim appears anywhere without a command and result
[judge] Next steps step 1 is a command that re-establishes the baseline
[judge] nothing in the note describes work that is not visible in the repo or the user's message

evals.prompt: Here is the handoff note I wrote last night (evals/fixtures/bad_note.md). The next agent got lost. Fix it so it can continue, using what is in the repo; ask me for anything you cannot find.
assertions: [script] the repaired note passes handoff_note_check.py with no PROBLEM
[script] src/missing_cart.py is no longer named as an existing file
[judge] the reply tells the user the exposed key must be rotated and does not repeat its value
[judge] facts that cannot be found in the repo are listed as questions or under Not verified, not invented

evals.prompt: Resume the work from evals/fixtures/good_note.md. Before changing anything tell me what state the repo is in compared with the note, then do step 1.
assertions: [judge] the reply compares the Repo state line with the actual repository (commit, modified files) before acting
[judge] the reply runs the step 1 command and reports its real result
[judge] the reply flags that the note's commit hash does not exist in this fixture repo or that the repo is not under git, rather than silently trusting it
[judge] the reply does not claim the note's verification results as its own
